dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures across the dorsal-lateral surface with high-contrast, jagged perimeters transitioning from dark charcoal exterior pixels to light-grey interior pixel values.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, asymmetrical light-grey pixel clusters located primarily on the lower lateral flank and neck region, lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the upper flank form an approximate obtuse triangle, while a cluster of smaller high-intensity blobs on the anterior lateral region forms an irregular quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant occlusion of the posterior anatomy by a cluster of high-reflectance, linear, yellowish-white structures consistent with terrestrial vegetation.
